prompt:
Create a premium high-fidelity desktop dashboard UI screenshot, landscape 1600x1000, for a Portuguese operations tool called "Dashboard Geral". Design concept: compact modular mosaic dashboard with precise grid, subtle thin utility-red index tabs and neutral ivory/white canvas, dark graphite text, blue primary selection, restrained signal red used only for navigation accents. Data-rich yet calm and legible. This is a direct screen capture style composition, no browser chrome, no device frame, no Safari toolbar. Preserve product terms and functions.

The top application header must be present and fully distinct from the filter panel below it. At header left: exact breadcrumb "Principal › Visão Geral". In the center: a clipped horizontally scrolling city update ticker, green refresh icon and "Sincronizado", visible sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", fade masks at both ends and subtle left/right chevrons indicating the sequence scrolls horizontally. At right: theme toggle and user avatar/profile. City names and dates are sample placeholders only.

Immediately below the header, full width, show the complete real filter panel in two clear rows, occupying enough vertical space for legible labels and controls:
First row: "Período", segmented switch with "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo" visible, select "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07".
Second row: four separate dropdown controls "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", then button "Limpar".
Never omit, shrink away, or summarize these controls as filter chips. Keep ticker in header and filters in their own bordered section.

Below, a left app navigation rail with grouped current labels exactly:
Principal — Visão Geral (selected), Análise, UTR, Comparação.
Operacional — Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado.
Marketing — Operacional Marketing, Marketing.
Main area begins with title "Resumo Operacional" and subheading "Ano 2026 · Semanas 05, 06, 07". Three compact, readable metric tiles: "Corridas ofertadas" 18.450; "Aderência" 74,8%; "Praças" 2. Below, a clear two-line series chart "Evolução diária", legend "Ofertadas" and "Aceitas", and a table card "Por praça" with rows Guarulhos, Centro, Total and columns Corridas / Aderência. Use an efficient modular mosaic layout with small section dividers and grid structure; prioritize the three metrics and data over decoration. All figures are illustrative mock data, not real product data. No fake statuses, no alerts, no invented feature copy.
demoData: Métricas e pares cidade/data são demonstrativos, não dados do Supabase.
